Print a fitted cure quantile regression object

Source: R/print.R
print.curequantile.Rd

This function prints the estimated coefficients from a fitted cure quantile regression model fit using curequantile. This function returns the estimates invisible to the user.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'curequantile'
print(x, tau = 0.5, ...)

Arguments

x

an object of class curequantile.

tau

quantile at which latency coefficients should be estimated.

...

other arguments.

Value

invisibly returns a matrix with rows corresponding to the incidence (gamma) and latency (beta) parameter estimates at the user-specified quantile tau.

Examples

library(survival)
fit_breast <- curequantile(Surv(log(Time), Delta) ~ Age + Size,
  data = breast_data, subset = 1:200)
print(fit_breast, tau = 0.25)
#>       (Intercept)         Age        Size
#> gamma   -4.414748 0.037609062  0.03203235
#> beta     3.555456 0.006326203 -0.01503508
